text:
One year ago, we had a big dream and a blank whiteboard. Today I'm looking back on our first year, and I'm proud of it.

We brought in $180K in revenue. Our team is 4 people, and they show up every day. In month 11 we had 17 paying customers, who believed in us before we had all the answers.

The path wasn't a straight line. We had 2 failed pivots, and each one taught us something we couldn't have learned any other way. Every "not quite" got us closer to the "yes."

What this year taught me:

Failure is data, not defeat. Small teams move fast when they move together. Customers are your compass, so listen more than you talk.

To everyone who took a chance on us: thank you, truly.

On to year two.

What did your first year teach you? Tell me in the comments.
